scenes.text: VAR can't review everything. It only steps in for four kinds of decision.
Goal or no goal. Penalty or no penalty. Direct red card. And mistaken identity: when the referee books the wrong player.
A foul in midfield that leads to nothing? Not reviewable, however wrong the call.
And even then, it has to be a clear and obvious error.
Players can't ask for it. Only the referee can start a review, and making the screen gesture risks a yellow card.
And VAR doesn't decide: it recommends. The final decision always belongs to the referee.
New this edition: a clearly incorrect second yellow can now be reviewed.
Save it, and share it with whoever screams for VAR every week.
